# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if site is associated with severity

print('\nSite vs Severity:\n', site_severity)

# Check if site is associated with arm
site_arm = pd.crosstab(data['site'], data['arm'])
print('\nSite vs Arm:\n', site_arm)"}
